title: Weather Today and Yesterday
text:
Today the weather is very nice. The sun is shining and the sky is blue. It is warm, so I wear a T-shirt.

Yesterday it was cold and it rained all day. I took my umbrella to school. Tomorrow, the weather will be windy.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
What did the speaker take to school yesterday?
Why does the speaker wear a T-shirt today?
What kind of day was yesterday compared with today?

vocabulary.definition: giving out light, as the sun does
an object you hold over your head to stay dry
when there is a lot of wind outside

paragraph_translations: Hoy el clima está muy agradable. El sol brilla y el cielo es azul. Hace calor, así que llevo una camiseta.
Ayer hizo frío y llovió todo el día. Llevé mi paraguas a la escuela. Mañana el clima será ventoso.
